lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns along the mid-flank. A high-density cluster of smaller blobs is situated in the region directly superior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a geometric grid. These intersections are most prominent in the anterior section of the flank, becoming more diffuse toward the caudal region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The primary ridge shows a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity (dorsal side) to low-intensity (ventral side) shadow, extending from the gill region to the base of the dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the leading edge and lower half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A reddish-brown circular lesion is visible on the mid-flank, positioned between the third and fourth vertical bands. Irregular pixel-level indentations are present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A transition to high-frequency, small-diameter high-luminance spots is visible on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit.
